# Data Source autosupport

Retrieve the AutoSupport configuration of a cluster

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* system node autosupport show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_autosupport" "autosupport" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) AutoSupport identifier
- `enabled` (Boolean) Specifies whether the AutoSupport daemon is enabled. When enabled, AutoSupport messages are generated
- `transport` (String) The name of the transport protocol used to deliver AutoSupport messages
- `to_addresses` (Set of String) Specifies up to five recipients of full AutoSupport e-mail messages
- `from` (String) The e-mail address from which the node sends AutoSupport messages
- `contact_support` (Boolean) Specifies whether AutoSupport notification to technical support is enabled
- `partner_addresses` (Set of String) Specifies up to five partner vendor recipients of full AutoSupport e-mail messages
- `proxy_url` (String) HTTP or HTTPS proxy if the transport parameter is set to HTTP or HTTPS
- `mail_hosts` (Set of String) List of mail server(s) used to deliver AutoSupport messages via SMTP. Specify hostnames or IP addresses. Ports are automatically selected based on smtp_encryption setting
- `is_minimal` (Boolean) Specifies whether the system information is collected in compliant form to remove private data or in complete form to enhance diagnostics
- `ondemand_enabled` (Boolean) Specifies whether the AutoSupport OnDemand Download feature is enabled. Requires ONTAP 9.16.1 or higher
- `smtp_encryption` (String) SMTP encryption type for AutoSupport messages. Valid values: none, start_tls. Requires ONTAP 9.15 or higher
